project.description: Seeded from a scope audit of /sessions/rcw-01selignehxwntgsnfurjwmx/mnt/elmos: 45790 files, 17 languages.
assumptions: Seeded by the scope auditor from measured repository facts plus configured defaults.
Durations and token profiles are seeds, not measurements; calibrate after the first milestone.
exclusions: Human approval and acceptance time (carried in human_assisted).
Vendor pricing (supply a verified rate card).
confidence_basis: 证据推导出的上限是 0.65（certifier.supported_confidence：底 0.30 + 已获得的证据项）。
已获得：运行时维度已用真实遥测校准 (+0.15)、无待人工决策的范围缺口 (+0.10)、Chaos 场景全部执行并通过 (+0.05)、费用基于已核验费率 (+0.05)。
未获得：运行时样本 >= 20 (+0.10)、token 维度已用真实用量校准 (+0.20)、token 样本 >= 20 (+0.10)、token 分类占比已对照实测用量 (+0.05)。
写在 seed 而不是产物里：0.60 之前是直接改在 project-forecast.json 上的，重跑 forecast 就被冲回 0.35。声明值属于源，不属于产物——改产物正是 confidence-is-supported 门禁要拦的那种动作。
上限变化时必须重新评估这个数，不要只因为想让门禁过就抬。

tokens.accounting_rule: input/cached_input/cache_write/output/reasoning_output are disjoint categories; total is their sum and must never be added back to a category.

mix_verification.detail: 分类占比已与真实用量对照过（见 TOKEN_MIX_COMPARISON.md）。**下表的费用建立在未经校准的假设占比上**，实测显示它对长任务高估明显、对短任务基本准确——具体倍数看那份报告的曲线，不要套一个固定倍数。

costs.cross_currency_note: Models priced in different currencies are never ranked against each other here. Supply a dated FX rate and do that conversion explicitly if it is needed.
costs.warning: Any model marked not_for_billing uses illustrative rates. It validates the arithmetic only and must not back a financial commitment.

human_assisted.definition: system autonomous wall-clock + non-parallelisable human review + approval/external waits

calendar_speedup.formula: human calendar weeks x 7 x 24 / system autonomous wall-clock hours
calendar_speedup.caveat: Human calendar weeks include nights and weekends; the system figure is continuous machine time.

reference_tokenizer.name: legacy Claude BPE tokenizer
reference_tokenizer.obtained_from: anthropic==0.21.3, anthropic/tokenizer.json (the last release that bundled it)
reference_tokenizer.caveat: This is NOT the tokenizer of any current model. It is a real BPE tokenizer of the right family and rough vocabulary scale, which makes it a far better yardstick than the 4-characters-per-token rule -- but it is a yardstick, not ground truth. Billing-grade counts still require the target provider's own counting endpoint.

calibration.note: calibrated_tokens = estimated_tokens / factor. The factor was measured against a real BPE tokenizer; it narrows the error, it does not make the count exact.
